digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge observability and CloudWatch integration
propositions: The Reconcile Bridge (running on GitHub Actions) failure was invisible to CloudWatch because the host observability probe cannot monitor GitHub Actions workflows, resulting in zero alarm coverage during the Jira API token outage.

GitHub Actions workflow must publish bridge_run_failures metric (1 on failure, 0 on success) to CloudWatch namespace rebar/host with OIDC authentication, gated on canonical repo and configured variables to skip in forks.

A new narrowly-scoped IAM role rebar-bridge-metrics must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData constrained by namespace condition to rebar/host, reusing the existing OIDC provider without widening existing roles.

CloudWatch alarm rebar-bridge-run-failures must trigger on the second failure within one hour (period 3600, threshold 1, GreaterThanThreshold) to distinguish transient blips from sustained outages like expired tokens.
Publishing 0 on success rather than relying on missing-data semantics makes the publisher itself observable and keeps the alarm in OK state during health, preventing false INSUFFICIENT_DATA signals.
